pussellawa-kandy-trip.line: 52 children saw Kandy for the first time, and came home singing on the bus.

picture.caption: The bus by Kandy Lake (example picture, no faces)

quotes.en: I saw an elephant for the first time!
We all sang together on the bus.

quotes.ta: இந்தக் குழந்தைகள் இன்று பெரிய உலகத்தைக் கண்டார்கள்.
quotes.en: Today these children saw a bigger world.

thanks.title: From the children, to the people who gave

to.name: Srikantha
to.words: Thank you for our day in Kandy. We will never forget it.

to.name: Anonymous friend
to.words: We don't know your name, but we sang for you too.

letter.words: Many of these children had never left the estate. Thank you for trusting us with your gift. Every rupee is shown below.
